scripts.caddy:trust: choco install caddy --yes --force && powershell -Command "Start-Process -NoNewWindow -FilePath 'caddy' -ArgumentList 'run --config Caddyfile'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; caddy trust; Stop-Process -Name caddy -Force"
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe build
scripts.docker:build:debug: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe build --no-cache
scripts.docker:run: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe up
scripts.docker:run:detach: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe up -d
scripts.docker:run:debug:infra: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml --profile infra up
scripts.docker:run:debug: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe up
scripts.docker:run:debug:detach: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml --profile infra --profile be --profile fe up -d
